# Market stall: four posts, a counter, a striped canopy sloping to the front, two jars. Up Z, facing -Y.
new
material new Post --base-color 0.647 0.541 0.384 --no-slot
material new Counter --base-color 0.647 0.541 0.384 --no-slot
material new Canopy --base-color 1 1 1 --no-slot
material new Jar --base-color 0.663 0.663 0.580 --no-slot
add mesh cube --name PostFL --size 1 --location -0.70 -0.45 0.75
scale 0.14 0.14 1.50
add mesh cube --name PostFR --size 1 --location 0.70 -0.45 0.75
scale 0.14 0.14 1.50
add mesh cube --name PostBL --size 1 --location -0.70 0.45 0.90
scale 0.14 0.14 1.80
add mesh cube --name PostBR --size 1 --location 0.70 0.45 0.90
scale 0.14 0.14 1.80
select PostFL PostFR PostBL PostBR
material assign Post
add mesh cube --name Counter --size 1 --location 0 -0.25 0.35
scale 1.30 0.45 0.70
material assign Counter
# the canopy: scaled, applied, THEN tilted (front edge lower: +X rotation lifts +Y), stripes run front to back
add mesh cube --name Canopy --size 1 --location 0 0 1.68
scale 1.70 1.25 0.08
apply --scale
set rotation 9 0 0
material assign Canopy
active Canopy
mode edit
select all
uv project-from-view top --scale-to-bounds
mode object
material texture Canopy base-color ../../art/textures/canopy_16.png
add mesh cylinder --name Jar1 --vertices 8 --radius 0.13 --depth 0.30 --location -0.35 -0.25 0.85
material assign Jar
add mesh cylinder --name Jar2 --vertices 8 --radius 0.11 --depth 0.24 --location 0.30 -0.20 0.82
material assign Jar
select all
apply --scale
shade flat
export stall.glb
